text: Kingsmoor FC showed great patience with 11 quick passes lasting nearly a minute, working their way from a throw-in deep in their own half to a golden chance. Viktor Quinlan’s clever short pass set up Felix Duarte, who took a shot from close range but missed, even though it was a chance that usually gets converted about half the time (xG 0.52) [#695-#713]. The score stayed tied 2-2 as Kingsmoor kept control, playing wide and waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
